source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information
And Compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print to check if contect correct or not

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/Chassis/FRU_SYS (FRU_SYS system chassis/FRU) so user can read/diff against SPEC for "FRU_SYS". No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES assumes FRU_SYS and samples identity plus Status through curl -k, but does not prove system-member identity, complete IPMI parity, Status freshness or static/live semantics.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED separates static identity from live Status and adds protected complete reconciliation with a no-power boundary.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 962/2291 accepts the command under only a generic read/write gate.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: SCM is a component FRU and Miramar is sensor telemetry; neither can substitute for system-level identity/status evidence.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 keeps WebUI/IPMI evidence; ED-34 permits approved equivalent collectors; ED-35 preserves full identity/status coverage; ED-36 makes expected values and mapping readiness inputs.

original_test_intent: Verify FRU_SYS identifies the intended system chassis and that readable system-level FRU information is correct across WebUI and IPMI.
original_method: Resolve the exact system chassis member, collect complete protected Redfish and IPMI records, compare static identity separately from current Status against WebUI and approved system/build references, and leave logs and power state unchanged.
manual_activity: The owner defines the system member, static FRU baseline and live Status meaning/tolerance. The agent may collect and normalize read-only evidence; the engineer owns any mismatch and final verdict.
safety_requirements: Do not power-cycle, reset, flash or write FRU data.
Resolve the system member from the live collection instead of assuming FRU_SYS.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials.
Do not treat Status as a static FRU field or static identity as proof of live health.
Stop on stale/unknown Status or ambiguous system mapping without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Bind the exact system chassis resource and IPMI FRU record.
Collect complete redacted static identity and contemporaneous Status evidence.
Capture matching WebUI detail and normalize fields with timestamps.
Compare identity to build reference and Status to approved health semantics.
Return evidence only with unchanged power and logs.
engineer_actions: Approve system-member mapping and field matrix.
Approve Status authority, freshness and expected health.
Review discrepancies and issue formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partial only: it assumes one URI, weakens TLS, omits IPMI/full-field parity and mixes live Status with static FRU identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Discover the exact system member, collect complete protected Redfish/IPMI data with timestamps, and compare static identity and live status through separate acceptance checkpoints.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FRU_SYS, WebUI/ipmitool comparison, Criterion and original time values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use complete system-FRU parity plus a separately timed live-status checkpoint under a no-power/no-write boundary.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, schema and IPMI decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor system inventory/Status definitions and Project build record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact member binding, complete protected evidence and separation of static identity from dynamic health while retaining source interfaces.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Four API properties are partial; correct identity cannot establish live health, and a transient Status cannot replace FRU comparison.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: System map, build baseline and Status semantics.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Cached or stale Status may look valid, and an incorrectly selected chassis resource can have plausible identifiers.

project_override_considerations: Alternate inventory/status sources require engineer approval, exact system identity, equivalent fields and freshness, plus explicit disclosure of uncovered WebUI/IPMI coverage.
expected_evidence: System chassis and IPMI identity mapping
Complete raw redacted records with collection timestamps
WebUI capture and approved build reference
Static identity matrix and separate Status/freshness assessment
Unchanged power/log/no-write audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master consistently requests readable/correct system inventory; the dynamic Status selected by DeepSeek is an added checkpoint whose semantics must be defined, not a contradictory source purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The system inventory purpose is clear; system mapping, reference values and Status policy are Project execution-readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds exact member proof, complete IPMI/UI parity and live/static separation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid classification and status-aware controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces generic direct execution with identity, freshness and no-power gates.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps system FRU distinct from component inventory and sensor telemetry.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible system object or stale Status from being accepted as complete system-FRU correctness and makes the live/static coverage split explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: FRU identity is persistent inventory, whereas Redfish Status is contemporaneous operational state and may be cached, absent or vendor-defined. They need separate expected values and timestamps; neither proves the other, and all comparisons require an exact system-object/IPMI mapping.
